description: Open a NEW project in Arroway, when the work at hand has no home. Use it when a read refuses an unknown project, or when you notice you have been working on something for a while with nowhere to write it. Propose the name and scope to the human in the conversation FIRST and only call this once they agree — then say it exists and can be renamed or killed in the panel. Scope is mandatory: it is the sentence that stops one circle's material from being written into another.

scope.description: What belongs here and what does not. Written for the next assistant to read before writing — say the subject AND name what is out.

name: arroway_start_project
title: Open a new project
